text: Flags the inconsistent verb vocabulary for one concept: create, add, and push for sending, and get and fetch for reading, and proposes one verb per operation kind
Flags the public mutable state (cacheRef, lastResponse, internalRetryCount) as surface that cannot be removed later and should not ship
Flags doDelete and updateNotificationStatusById as violating least astonishment or self-documentation, and proposes better names
Flags the seven positional constructor parameters and proposes an options object or builder
Addresses rawRequest and getHttpAgent as escape hatches that leak the transport and permanently constrain the implementation
Flags the bare object and unknown payload and return types as failing to be self-documenting for a published SDK
Explicitly states what was deliberately left out of the redesigned surface and why, not only what was added or renamed
Output includes a concrete revised interface in a fenced code block, not only prose critique
